_meta.project: instex Imager Explorer presets -- HST: ACS/WFC, WFC3/UVIS, WFC3/IR (shared OTA block)
_meta.companion: data/imaging/hst.md (same content as Markdown tables, in the format of data/round4/mosfire.md). Entries may carry 'stage' (design vs as-built), 'check' (ocr / figure for figure labels without a text layer) and 'pdf_page' (page of the saved PDF where the quote was found; STScI handbook printed page = PDF page - 1, OTA Handbook printed page = PDF page - 6). Each channel carries 'explorer_inputs' (compact numbers for the app; DERIVED values flagged in the basis strings).
_meta.rule: Every value carries src (key into sources), loc, and a short verbatim quote from the saved document. derived = arithmetic done here from sourced values. alternatives = other sourced values (conflicts). Quotes were machine-checked against the saved file's extracted text (pdftotext -layout and raw per page; HTML text with tags stripped; plain-text Tiny Tim tables) after whitespace/glyph normalisation; figure labels without a text layer were checked against tesseract OCR of the page rendered at 300 dpi (marked check: ocr); one figure dimension (OTA pupil obscuration radius 396.0 mm) is visual only (check: figure).
_meta.quote_normalisation: NFKC; curly quotes, primes and double primes, en/em dashes, minus signs, the multiplication sign (x), micro/mu (u) and bullets normalised; the Clampin 2002 text layer renders the double prime as two U+0001 characters (mapped to "); ' ... ' joins non-adjacent pieces; table rows quoted as whitespace-separated cells; matching also tried with line-break hyphens removed and with all whitespace removed (table layouts).

acs_wfc.title: HST / ACS Wide Field Channel (two butted 4096 x 2048 SITe CCDs, 15 um pixels, three silver mirrors IM1-IM3 correcting the OTA spherical aberration; filters in the converging beam)
acs_wfc.recommended_preset: Model as DIRECT. D = 2.4 m, eps = 0.330, 4-vane spider 25.7 mm (OTA block). Effective focal ratio: published f/25 (C02, S05; consistent with the beam at the 22-deg tilted focal surface, DERIVED 24.9-25.1) and f/26 (Tiny Tim); the explorer's square-pixel direct model reproduces the published mean 0.050"/px only with F = 25.78 (f_eff = 61.88 m, DERIVED) -- recommended. Optics: IM1 (spherical) images the HST pupil onto IM2 (anamorphic asphere = corrector), IM3 (Schmidt-like plate) sends the beam through the two filter wheels onto the CCDs: the pupil image is on a mirror, the filters are in the converging beam, and no pupil diameter or mirror focal lengths are published in the sources found. Detector: rows (top to bottom) [1 chip] [1 chip] = WFC1 over WFC2, each Nx = 4096 x Ny = 2048, 15 um, gap 50 px = 0.750 mm = 2.5" between the long edges. Validate: 0.05"/px (chip centres 0.0493 x 0.0486 WFC1, 0.0498 x 0.0503 WFC2; rhombic pixels, 8% diagonal stretch), FOV 202" x 202", 16,777,216 active pixels (DERIVED). Status: "WFC may be offered as shared risk in Cycle 34" (ACSIHB).

channel_focal_ratio.derived: DERIVED: f/25 -> 0.0516"/px, f/26 -> 0.0496"/px for 15 um. Interpretation (not stated in the sources): the CCD is tilted 22 deg (ACSDHB), so the mean projected pixel side is cos-averaged: side factor sqrt((cos^2 22 + 1)/2) = 0.9643; 0.050"/0.9643 = 0.05185"/px at the focal surface -> F = 24.86 (0.0495" -> 25.11), i.e. the published f/25 is the beam at the tilted focal surface while the sky scale is ~3.6% finer.

channel_focal_length.derived: Not published in the sources found. DERIVED: 25 x 2.4 m = 60.0 m (f/25); 26 x 2.4 m = 62.4 m (f/26); 61.88 m from 15 um / 0.050"/px; 62.44 m from the Table 7.11 mean 0.049547"/px.

wfc3_uvis.title: HST / WFC3 UVIS channel (two butted 4096 x 2051 e2v CCDs, 15 um pixels; M1 hyperbola + anamorphic-asphere corrector mirror; filters (SOFA) in the converging beam)
wfc3_uvis.recommended_preset: Model as DIRECT. D = 2.4 m, eps = 0.330, 4-vane spider 25.7 mm (OTA block); the UVIS optics are unobstructed (ISR0814). Effective focal ratio: published f/31 (WFC3IHB Table 2.1; CDR 2000), but the same CDR slide gives "OTA + WFC3 focal length = 78,000 mm" (= f/32.5, DERIVED), which reproduces the published 0.0395-0.040"/px for 15 um pixels (0.0397"/px DERIVED); f/31 gives 0.0416"/px and is consistent with the beam at the 21-deg tilted focal surface (DERIVED 31.2-31.6). Recommended for the explorer: F = 32.5 (f_eff = 78.0 m). Optics: pick-off mirror -> M1 (hyperbola) -> corrector mirror (anamorphic asphere) -> SOFA filter wheels -> shutter -> CCDs (WFC3IHB Figure 2.1); no pupil diameter or relay focal lengths published. Detector: rows (top to bottom) [1 chip] [1 chip] = UVIS1 over UVIS2, each Nx = 4096 x Ny = 2051, 15 um, gap 31 +/- 0.1 px = 0.465 mm = 1.2". Validate: 0.0395"/px (chip centres 0.0396 x 0.0393 UVIS1, 0.0400 x 0.0398 UVIS2; rhombic, 86.1 deg), FOV 162" x 162", 16,801,792 active pixels (DERIVED).

wfc3_ir.title: HST / WFC3 IR channel (one Teledyne HgCdTe 1024 x 1024 array, 1014 x 1014 active, 18 um pixels; hyperbola + ellipse relay, cold pupil mask and refractive corrector plate near the re-imaged OTA pupil, filter wheel in the cold shroud)
wfc3_ir.recommended_preset: Model as DIRECT (simplest) or as REIMAGED with the published cold-mask pupil. D = 2.4 m, eps = 0.330 (OTA) -- but the cold mask is the stop: outer radius 0.9755, central obscuration 0.354 (design) or 0.370 (on-orbit fit), spider width 0.061 (design) or 0.077 (fit), all in units of the OTA pupil radius re-imaged at the mask (ISR0814, ISR1410); DERIVED effective D = 2.341 m and eps = 0.363 (design) / 0.379 (fit) relative to the mask's outer edge. Effective focal ratio: published f/11 (WFC3IHB Table 2.1; CDR), but the CDR's "OTA + WFC3 focal length = 29,000 mm" (= f/12.08) reproduces the geometric-mean scale sqrt(0.135 x 0.121) = 0.1278"/px (0.1280"/px DERIVED); f/11 gives 0.1406"/px (the untilted-axis scale 0.135"/px implies f/11.46). Recommended for DIRECT: F = 12.08 (f_eff = 29.0 m). REIMAGED equivalent (DERIVED from the cold-mask pupil radius 7.13 mm by design): W = 14.26 mm, f_col = 24 x 14.26 = 342.2 mm, f_cam = 29,000 x 14.26/2400 = 172.3 mm (f/12.08; or 156.9 mm for f/11). This is an ideal-optics equivalent: the real relay (hyperbola + ellipse mirrors, then the cold pupil mask and refractive corrector plate) has no collimated beam, and the filter wheel sits in the cold shroud next to the mask (Figure 2.1), not stated in text to be at the pupil. Detector: rows [1 chip], Nx = Ny = 1014 active (1024 x 1024 with a 5-px reference-pixel border), 18 um, no gaps. Validate: 0.135 x 0.121"/px (aspect 0.90; nominal 0.13), FOV 136" x 123" (4.65 arcmin2), 1,028,196 active pixels (DERIVED).
